# Psalm 99 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 99:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** YHWH reigns, let-tremble the-peoples; enthroned-on the-cherubim, let-quake the-earth.
- **LOGOS:** The LORD reigns; let the peoples tremble! He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake!
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD is king! Let the nations tremble! He sits enthroned above the angels! Let the whole earth shake!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 99:6 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** Moses and-Aaron among-his-priests, and-Samuel among-those-calling-on his-name; calling to-YHWH and-he would-answer-them.
- **LOGOS:** Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel also was among those who called upon his name. They cried to the LORD, and he answered them.
- **PNEUMA:** Moses and Aaron served as his priests; Samuel was among those who called on his name. They called out to the LORD, and he answered them.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** O LORD our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, but an avenger of their wrongdoings.
- **PNEUMA:** LORD our God, you answered their prayers. You were a God who forgave them, even while holding them accountable for their actions.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
